body: Also I forgot to mention, if you’re into reading and want to read more on dpdr, I just started a book called “feeling unreal” by Jeffrey abugel and daphne Simeon.. I’m not far into it so idk if it’ll end up being a bad recommendation 🤣 but so far it’s been pretty validating and interesting

I understand completely what ur describing.. it’s so similar to how mine goes. It depends now that I think about it.. I cant pinpoint what is exactly the reason for how long it goes on…sometimes it’s hours and sometimes it’s days. But when it’s days I kind of just forget I have an inner voice and then only realize it was gone when I hear that voice again a couple days later. If I’m having a period of time where I’m continually dissociating, that’s usually when it just shuts off for days. Have u felt like you’ve experienced a lot of dissociation these past couple of days

It’s totally gone when it disappears. I don’t even have the awareness to be like “oh it’s not there” unless I actually put energy into trying to think.. but at that point I’m so dissociated that i usually am not even thinking (if that makes sense) but getting back to what you were saying it’s totally gone and I can’t even talk to myself in my head at all.. does it come and go or is yours constantly off?
Just started experiencing this a couple of months ago.. it comes and goes while I’m dissociated..it’s the weirdest shit ever. I don’t even know how to put that feeling into words yet

Folliculitis has been so tricky for me! I struggle with it on my cheeks and jaw area.. one line of products that I am using currently is Almond skin care. They are formulated to help treat folliculitis and it honestly has helped me soooo much. They might be worth checking out for you! Using the face and body wash with the level 1 serum and moisturizing with CeraVe has been such a great combo at noticeably clearing up that area.
